name: Chat Bubble
description: Conversation message bubbles for AI assistant chat, with user and AI distinct styles, role labels, streaming/reasoning/tool-call support. 时间戳显示在一轮对话的开始处，即用户气泡的正上方，水平居中

variants.name: Greeting
variants.description: Centered AI greeting message shown in empty state

variants.name: User Message
variants.description: User's question in primary-100 bubble aligned to the right, on-surface text color

variants.name: AI Response
variants.description: AI's reply in white bubble with outline-variant border and subtle shadow, aligned to the left

variants.name: Streaming
variants.description: Streaming output state: shows 14x14 loading indicator when empty, blinking cursor at end when content is present

variants.name: Reasoning
variants.description: AI thinking/reasoning process, displayed in a collapsible region

variants.name: Tool Call
variants.description: Tool invocation indicator, rendered as a pill with light primary background

variants.name: Tool Result
variants.description: Tool execution result, displayed in a collapsible region

states.name: long-press-copy
states.description: Long press to copy message content
